context: Asuka mentors Ren about pursuing teaching as a career.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: レン君、教える仕事、決心、ついた？
lines.en: Ren-kun — have you come to a decision about the teaching work?
lines.style: Open with gentle curiosity, eyebrows lifted slightly. Warm, steady tone. Lean in just enough to show you're genuinely asking. No rush in the pacing. The care comes through in the spaces between words.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Soft opening, a small breath before speaking. Voice stays quiet and level. Slight downward inflection — not defeated, just thoughtful. Eyes meet hers briefly before looking away. Genuine admission without performance.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 指導者、向いてる、感じる。
lines.en: I think you have real aptitude for guiding others.
lines.style: Steady, affirming tone. Light emphasis on 「向いてる」 — not pushing, just naming something you see clearly. Warm but grounded. Speak as if this is an observation, not flattery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 将来、もう少し、考えます。
lines.en: I'll think about the future a little more.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause at the start. Slow, deliberate pacing. Voice stays soft but carries intention. Not evasive — genuinely considering. Subtle nod at the end, inward-turning.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: We can figure this out together.
lines.style: Gentle, collaborative tone. Speak directly, without distance. The word 「一緒に」 carries the whole offer — you're not going to figure this alone. Warm close at the end, like a small promise.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: I'm genuinely grateful for this conversation.
lines.style: Sincere, unguarded. The gratitude lands on 「感謝」 naturally. Voice softens slightly. Not effusive — just real and present. Brief eye contact, then a small exhale of relief.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: This decision matters. Take your time.
lines.style: Quiet, settled tone. Weight on 「大切な」 — you understand the significance. Slow, patient pacing. Speak as if you have nowhere else to be. Close with gentleness, not pressure.
